title: ComfyUI Game Asset Toolkit
summary: A custom Node.js client, CLI, and workflow recipes for generating artwork, transparent cutouts, upscaled images, music, and sound effects.
description:
A toolkit for driving a local ComfyUI server from scripts and agent tools. It supports node and model discovery, workflow validation, uploads, queued generation, status polling, and downloading completed assets.

The game-asset recipes cover SDXL artwork, BiRefNet transparent cutouts, Real-ESRGAN upscaling, ACE-Step music, and Stable Audio sound effects. Recorded execution checks include a potion icon and cutout, image upscaling, instrumental music, and impact and ambience audio. Running generation requires a separately configured ComfyUI server and the relevant models.

This project supplies orchestration and recipes around ComfyUI and existing models; those upstream tools and model creators retain their own attribution and licenses.
